tr: Can you tell me the time? / Sure, it's five o'clock.
Where's the key? / It's on the table.
What's the dog's name? / His name is Max.
Good morning, ma'am. / Good morning. How can I help you?
Hi, Diego. How are you? / Really good, and you?
Good afternoon, Don Javier. How are you? / Fine, thank you. And you?
This is my friend Lucía. / Nice to meet you, Lucía.
Hi, what's your name? / My name is Mateo, and yours?
Good morning, what's your name? / My name is Alejandro Ruiz.
Where are you from, Valeria? / I'm from Monterrey, but I live in Puebla.
What do you do? / I'm a nurse. I work in a hospital.
Do you have any brothers or sisters? / Yes, I have one sister and two brothers.
Do your parents live here? / No, my parents live in Puebla.
This is my husband, Javier. / Nice to meet you, Javier.
Hey, what time is it? / It's ten after four.
Excuse me, what time do you open tomorrow? / We open at ten.
How much is this hat? / It's three hundred pesos.
See you on Monday? / Yes, Monday at ten.
What day is it today? / Today is Thursday.
When is your birthday? / My birthday is March 8.
What are you going to eat? / Some tamales and a coffee.
Anything to drink? / A glass of water, please.
And for you? / A cheese quesadilla for me.
Can I help you with anything? / I'm just looking, thanks.
Do you have a bigger size? / Yes, here's a large.
How's the shirt? / I love it. I'll take it.
Do you live in a house? / No, I live in an apartment downtown.
Is there milk for the coffee? / No, there's no milk. I'm going to the store.
What time do you get up? / I get up at seven, and you?
Excuse me, where is there a bank? / There's one on the corner, next to the pharmacy.
Excuse me, how do I get to the museum? / Go straight for two blocks and turn right.
Sorry, I'm lost. Where is the station? / It's very close. Cross the street and there it is.
A round-trip ticket, please. / Sure. That's three hundred pesos.
Is this seat free? / Yes, have a seat.
Is breakfast included? / Yes, it's from seven to ten.
What's wrong, Diego? / I have a fever and everything hurts.
Do you want to walk some more? / No, thanks. My feet hurt.
How do you feel today? / Much better, thanks.
Shall we get a coffee at ten thirty? / I can't, I have a meeting at ten.
Do you go to the office every day? / No, I work from home on Mondays and Fridays.
Teacher, how do you say this in Spanish? / It's ‹el lápiz›.
Shall we go to the movies tonight? / Not today, I'm sleepy.
What's wrong, Lucía? / I'm worried about tomorrow's test.
Are you ready? We're leaving now. / Yes, I'm ready.
I really like tamales. / Me too!
What did you do on the weekend? / I went to the beach with my family.
Do you want to go to the beach on Saturday? / Yes! I love the beach.
Where do you work, Mateo? / I work at a hospital in Monterrey.
Who do you live with? / I live with my sister and her dog.
Coffee or tea? / Coffee, please, no sugar.
Why don't you sing? / Because I'm embarrassed.
Shall we eat now? / Yes, please. I'm very hungry.
I'm cold. Can you close the window? / Sure, I'll close it right now.
Yanelis, what do you want from the corner store? / A passion fruit juice, please.
How do you get to work? / I take the bus on the corner.
Wilson, how's your new car? / It's great!
Thanks for the meal. Everything was delicious. / I'm so glad. Do you want more?
You're a really good cook, Mariana! / Thanks, it's my mom's recipe.
I finished the project on time. / Well done!
What if we go to the park on Saturday? / What a great idea!
I'll help you with the bags. / Thanks, you're very kind.
How's the jacket? / It looks great on you.
You speak Spanish really well. / Thanks, but I still have a lot to learn.
What a lovely home you have! / Thanks, that's kind of you.
My name is Valeria. / You have a really pretty name.
How do I look? / You look great! I love that dress.
Hi, Mateo. Sorry I'm late. / No problem. You look gorgeous today.
You look really handsome in that shirt. / Thanks, I bought it yesterday.
Why are you smiling? / Because you make me laugh a lot.
I love your smile. / Oh, thanks. I'm embarrassed.
You have beautiful eyes. / Thanks, they're like my mom's.
I get lost in your eyes. / Oh, please! That's straight out of a movie.
I'm taking you to dinner on Friday. / Is this a date?
I had a really good time with you. / Me too. Shall we do it again soon?
I really like you, Sofía. / You too, Diego. You're really cool.
I have to tell you something: I like you. / Really? I like you too.
Hi! I missed you. / I missed you too. How was your trip?
Can I have your number? / Sure, it's five five, two three…
Are you free on Saturday? / Yes, why?
Can I buy you a coffee tomorrow? / I'd love to! What time?
Do you want to go out with me on Saturday? / Of course. Where are we going?
You're the prettiest girl at the party. / Oh, what a flirt!
You have a beautiful smile. / You say that to all the girls.
Do you want to go out with me on Friday? / Thanks, but I'm not interested. You're very kind.
I really like you, Lucía. / Thanks for telling me. I'd rather we be friends.
Can I buy you a drink? / Thanks, but I have a boyfriend.
Hey, Diego! Are you coming to the party? / Sure! I'll get there at eight.
Ouch! My foot hurts. / Are you okay? Sit here.
Class is at nine, not at ten. / Ah, now I get it! Thanks.
My sister has a baby. / Oh, how lovely! Congratulations.
Hey! That's my seat. / Sorry, I didn't see it.
I speak four languages. / Wow! That's amazing.
Do you think it'll be sunny tomorrow? / I hope so! I want to go to the beach.
Careful! A car is coming. / Thanks! I didn't see it.
I passed the test! / Bravo! Really well done.
I made the tacos all by myself. / Wow! They're really good.
Come on, we're leaving! / I'm coming, I'm coming!
The restaurant is closed today. / Oh man! So what do we eat now?
We're here. That's ten floors. / Phew! I'm really tired.
So I turn right at the corner? / Uh-huh! And then go straight.
Achoo! / Bless you!
Mom, he has my ball and won't give it to me. / Enough, kids! Off to bed.
Oops! Sorry, that's your coffee. / No problem.
This is my new apartment. / Wow! It's so big!
The ticket costs a thousand pesos. / Gosh! That's really expensive.
Watch out for the dog! It bites. / Thanks, I won't go near it.
I have a hard test tomorrow. / You can do it! You'll be fine.
Look out! The floor is wet. / Oh, thanks!
Shall we meet at six at the café? / Deal! See you there.
Do you want to try my fish soup? / Yuck! I don't like fish.
They say it's going to rain tomorrow. / Bah! Let's go to the beach anyway.
